```{r}
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(ggrain)
```

```{r}
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem <- read.xlsx("core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem.xlsx")
psilaut_dem <- read.xlsx("psilaut_dem_outlier.xlsx")
AQ_DACS <- read.csv("PSILAUT_MASTER_Spreadsheet_CE_MD_5DASC.csv")
AQ_DACS <- AQ_DACS %>% 
  rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID)
psilaut_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  select(- "Sex", -"Group", -"IQ", -"Age", - "AQ") %>% 
  left_join(AQ_DACS)
psilaut_dem$Group <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Group)
psilaut_dem$Sex <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Sex)
psilaut_dem$Dose <- as.factor(psilaut_dem$Dose)

core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$Dose <- as.factor(core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$Dose)  
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$Sex <- as.factor(core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$Sex)  
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$Group <- as.factor(core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$Group)  
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$v <- as.factor(core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem$v)  
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem)

qs_psilaut <- read.xlsx("RBQ2A_OCIR.xlsx")
srs_psilaut <- read.xlsx("PSILAUT_SRS_Scores.xlsx", sheet = "Sheet1")
had_psilaut <- read.csv("PSILAUT_MASTER_Spreadsheet_AUTISM_YG.csv")
sensory_psilaut <- read.xlsx("PSILAUT_sensory.xlsx")
beh_pca <- read.xlsx("beh_pca.xlsx")
```
## demographic data
```{r}
library(rstatix)
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  group_by(Dose, Group) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(Age, type = "mean_sd") 

core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  distinct(PSILAUT_no) %>% 
  separate(col = "PSILAUT_no", sep = -4, into = c("PS", "ID")) %>% 
  separate(col = "ID", sep = -3, into = c("Gender", "no")) %>% 
  separate(col = "no", sep = -2, into = c("Group", "no")) %>% 
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  count(Gender)
 
unique_cns_no %>% 
  count(Group)
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == 0) %>%
  t_test(Age ~ Group)
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  group_by(Group, Dose) %>% 
  count(Sex) 
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == "0") %>% 
  count(Group)
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == "5") %>% 
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(Age, type = "mean_sd") 
```
# Subjective effects
```{r}
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == "5") %>% 
  group_by(Group) %>% 
  get_summary_stats(DASC_total, type = "mean_sd") 
```

```{r}
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem_plb <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == "0")
t.test(data = core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem_plb, DASC_total ~ Group)
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem_dose5 <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == "5")
t.test(data = core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem, DASC_total ~  Group)
DASC_dose5_paired <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  select(Dose, Group, CNS_no, DASC_total) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Dose, values_from = DASC_total)
t.test(DASC_dose5_paired$`0`, DASC_dose5_paired$`5`, paired = TRUE)
```


```{r}
AQ_DACS %>% 
  filter(Dose != 2) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(Dose),  y = DASC_total, colour = as.factor(Group), fill = as.factor(Group))) +
  geom_rain(rain.side = 'f2x2', id.long.var = "PSILAUT_no")
```

### lm -baseline differences
```{r}
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  filter(Dose == 0 )
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem <- qs_psilaut %>% 
  right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem)
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem <- srs_psilaut %>% 
  rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID) %>% 
  right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem)
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem <- sensory_psilaut %>% 
    rename("CNS_no" = ID) %>% 
  right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem)
had_psilaut$Dose <- as.factor(had_psilaut$Dose)
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem <- had_psilaut %>% 
    rename("PSILAUT_no" = ID) %>% 
    right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem)
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem <- beh_pca %>% 
    right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem)
```

### visualisation
```{r}
library(ggrain)
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Group, y = ic5, fill = Group, color = Group)) +
  geom_rain(alpha = .5) +
  theme_classic() +
  #scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'PRGn') +
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = 'PRGn', labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'PRGn', labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = 'PRGn')  +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange")) +
  # scale_color_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange"), labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Groups",
                      labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                      values = c("dodgerblue", "darkorange")) +   
  # scale_shape_manual(name = "Groups",
                     # labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                     # values = c(1, 2)) +
  guides(fill = 'none', col = 'none', shape = 'none') +
#  stat_boxplot(aes(color= asd), geom="errorbar",position=position_dodge(width=0.5),width=0.1) + 
#  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = asd),position=position_dodge(width =0.5),width=0.4) + 
#  geom_line(aes( group= id, color = asd)) + 
#  geom_point(aes(fill=asd,color = asd, group= id ),pch=21) + 
#  stat_pvalue_manual(df_p_val1,label = "p.adj.signif",label.size=6,hide.ns = T) + # p values
  coord_cartesian() + # coord
  labs(
    x = "Groups",
    y = "Core Network Strength"
  ) +
  # scale_fill_manual(labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) + # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = fils) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),"cm"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    axis.text= element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, b = 3)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 10, l = 3)),
    # legend.position = c(0.95,0.85),
    legend.background = element_rect(colour = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.margin = margin(t=2, l=2,r=2,b=2)
  )
```

### vsl
```{r}
library(ggrain)
mean_cns <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  select(Group, Dose, starts_with("ic")) %>% 
  group_by(Group, Dose) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), mean))
drug_order = c('0', '5')
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(Dose, level = drug_order), y = ic5, fill = Group, color = Group, shape = Group)) +
  geom_line(data = mean_cns,aes(x = factor(Dose, level = drug_order), y = ic5, group = Group), linewidth=1.5) +
  geom_rain(alpha = .3, rain.side = 'f2x2', id.long.var = "PSILAUT_no",
            violin.args = list(color = NA, alpha = .7),
            boxplot.args = list(width = .07, alpha = .5),
            point.args = list(size = 2),
            boxplot.args.pos = list(width = .5,
                position = ggpp::position_dodgenudge(width = .1, #width needed now in ggpp version 0.5.g
                  x = c(-.2, -.13, # pre versicolor, pre virginica
                        .13, .2))), # post; post
            violin.args.pos = list(width = .7,
             position = position_nudge(x = c(rep(-.4, 256*2), rep(-.4, 256*2),# pre; pre
                                             rep(.4, 256*2), rep(.4, 256*2))))) + #post; post 
  theme_classic() +
  #scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'PRGn') +
  #scale_color_brewer(palette = 'PRGn', labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  # scale_fill_brewer(palette = 'PRGn', labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  # scale_color_brewer(palette = 'PRGn')  +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Groups",
                     labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                     values = c(1, 2)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "#F9A620")) +
   # scale_color_manual(values=c("dodgerblue", "darkorange"), labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) +
  scale_colour_manual(name = "Groups",
                      labels = c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic'),
                      values=c("dodgerblue", "#F9A620")) +   
  
  guides(fill = 'none') +
#  stat_boxplot(aes(color= asd), geom="errorbar",position=position_dodge(width=0.5),width=0.1) + 
#  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = asd),position=position_dodge(width =0.5),width=0.4) + 
#  geom_line(aes( group= id, color = asd)) + 
#  geom_point(aes(fill=asd,color = asd, group= id ),pch=21) + 
#  stat_pvalue_manual(df_p_val1,label = "p.adj.signif",label.size=6,hide.ns = T) + # p values
  coord_cartesian() + # coord
  labs(
    x = "Drugs",
    y = "Posterior Default Mode Network"
  ) +
  # scale_fill_manual(labels=c('Non-autistic', 'Autistic')) + # 
  # scale_fill_manual(values = fils) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels=c('Placebo', '5mg psilocybin')) +
  theme(
    plot.margin = unit(c(0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5),"cm"),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    axis.text= element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10, b = 3)),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 10, l = 3)),
    legend.inside.position = c(0.95,0.85),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, color = "black",
                              face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.margin = margin(t=2, l=2,r=2,b=2)
  )
```

### shifts
```{r}
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_shifts <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_dem %>% 
  select(PSILAUT_no, meanFD_hariri, ic6, Dose, Group, Sex, Age, AQ) %>% 
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(ic6, meanFD_hariri), names_from = Dose) %>% 
  mutate("ic6_shift" = ic6_5 - ic6_0)
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_shifts <- core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_shifts %>% 
  drop_na(c(6:7))
core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_shifts <- beh_pca %>% %>% 
    right_join(core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_shifts)

summary(lm(data = core_netstr_hariripsi_dose5_shifts, scale(ic6_shift) ~ scale(Comp.1) + Sex + scale(Age) + scale(meanFD_hariri_5) + scale(meanFD_hariri_0)))

```

# demographics
```{r}
core_netstr_hariripsi_plb_dem %>% 
  get_summary_stats(Age, type = "full")
?get_summary_stats
chisq.test
summary_behavior_hariri_dose05$Sex
gender <- summary_behavior_hariri_dose05 %>% 
  group_by(Dose, Group) %>% 
  count(Sex)
gender_plb <- gender %>% 
  filter(Dose == "0")
gender_plb_wider <- gender_plb %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = n)
tab <- as.matrix(gender_plb_wider[, 3:4])
rownames(tab) <- gender_plb_wider$Group
chisq.test(tab)
chisq.test(tab)$residuals

gender_dose5 <- gender %>% 
  filter(Dose == "5")
gender_dose5_wider <- gender_dose5 %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sex, values_from = n)
tab <- as.matrix(gender_dose5_wider[, 3:4])
rownames(tab) <- gender_dose5_wider$Group
chisq.test(tab)
chisq.test(tab)$residuals
```



#Reaction time & accuracy
```{r}
summary_behavior_hariri <- read.xlsx("summary_behavior_hariri.xlsx")
library(rstatix)

summary_behavior_hariri <- summary_behavior_hariri %>% 
  select(sub_visit, sum_accuracy, block, mean_RT) %>% 
  pivot_wider(values_from = c(sum_accuracy, mean_RT), names_from = block) %>% 
  mutate(sum_acc = sum_accuracy_face + sum_accuracy_shape) %>% 
  mutate(mean_RT = (mean_RT_face + mean_RT_shape)/2) %>% 
  right_join(psilaut_dem) 
```

## GLM
```{r}
summary_behavior_hariri$Group <- as.factor(summary_behavior_hariri$Group)
summary_behavior_hariri$Dose <- as.factor(summary_behavior_hariri$Dose)
summary_behavior_hariri$Sex <- as.factor(summary_behavior_hariri$Sex)
summary_behavior_hariri <- psilaut_dem %>% 
  select(sub_visit, beh_outlier, Group, Dose, CNS_no, Sex, Age, IQ, AQ) %>% 
  left_join(summary_behavior_hariri)


summary_behavior_hariri_clean <- summary_behavior_hariri %>% 
  filter(beh_outlier != 1 & fd_outlier != 1)

summary_behavior_hariri_clean$Dose <- as.factor(summary_behavior_hariri_clean$Dose)
summary_behavior_hariri_clean$Group <- as.factor(summary_behavior_hariri_clean$Group)
summary_behavior_hariri_clean <- summary_behavior_hariri %>% 
  filter(beh_outlier != 1 & fd_outlier != 1)
summary_behavior_hariri_clean <- summary_behavior_hariri_clean %>% 
  mutate(accuracy = (sum_acc/48)*100)
summary_behavior_hariri_clean %>%
  group_by(Dose, Group) %>%
  get_summary_stats(accuracy, type = "mean_sd")
summary_behavior_hariri_clean %>%
  group_by(Dose, Group) %>%
  get_summary_stats(mean_RT, type = "mean_sd")

summary_behavior_hariri_plb <- summary_behavior_hariri_clean %>% 
  filter(Dose == 0)
t.test(summary_behavior_hariri_plb$sum_acc ~ summary_behavior_hariri_plb$Group)
t.test(summary_behavior_hariri_plb$mean_RT ~ summary_behavior_hariri_plb$Group)

summary_behavior_hariri_dose5 <- summary_behavior_hariri_clean %>% 
  filter(Dose == 5)
t.test(summary_behavior_hariri_dose5$sum_acc ~ summary_behavior_hariri_dose5$Group)
t.test(summary_behavior_hariri_dose5$mean_RT ~ summary_behavior_hariri_dose5$Group)

summary_behavior_hariri_dose05 <- summary_behavior_hariri_clean %>% 
  filter(Dose != 2)

summary_behavior_hariri_dose_paired <-summary_behavior_hariri_dose05 %>% 
  select(Dose, Group, CNS_no, mean_RT, sum_acc, DASC_total) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Dose, values_from = c(mean_RT, sum_acc, DASC_total))
t.test(summary_behavior_hariri_dose_paired$sum_acc_0, summary_behavior_hariri_dose_paired$sum_acc_5, paired = TRUE)
t.test(summary_behavior_hariri_dose_paired$mean_RT_0, summary_behavior_hariri_dose_paired$mean_RT_5, paired = TRUE)
```
